items.text: The Eagles will play their first game on Sunday without Jalen Hurts.
items.why: Calf blood clot; confirmed first game without him, Tanner McKee starts.
items.implication: McKee at QB with top pass-catchers healthy but thin RB room.
items.opportunity: Boost to DeVonta Smith, Goedert, Wicks volume.

items.text: Breece Hall listed OUT on Sunday FantasyFootball injuries roundup.
items.why: Quad; missed practice, third straight game out.
items.implication: Braelon Allen shoulders load again vs Patriots.

items.text: Eagles ruled out RB Saquon Barkley for Sunday’s game against the Panthers.
items.why: Ruled out by team/Schefter after missing practice.
items.implication: Eagles thin at RB with Will Shipley also OUT; Tanner McKee starts at QB.
items.opportunity: Increased work for remaining backs/pass-catchers like DeVonta Smith, Goedert, Wicks.

items.text: Ravens ruled out Lamar Jackson for Sunday’s game at Cleveland due to his ankle injury.
items.why: Ankle; DNP and ruled out for second straight game.
items.implication: Tyler Huntley starts again; downgrade to Ravens pass game.

items.text: Unclear on questionable AJ Brown (ankle) as of now; practiced limited all week.
items.why: Ankle; limited practice, status unclear per Levitan. Berry notes possible return.
items.implication: Monitor for Patriots; high-ankle context for Henderson too.
items.opportunity: If out, boost to other NE pass catchers.

items.text: Caleb Williams Q tag seems more like probable after full practices.
items.why: Hamstring; full practice, Levitan views as probable.
items.implication: Likely plays vs Falcons; good spot.
items.opportunity: Bears pass catchers like Odunze/Burden if active.

items.text: Tyler Warren (groin) was a Friday addition as questionable.
items.why: Groin injury during Friday drills, added to report.

items.text: Tanner McKee will have PHI's 4th-string RB (Dameon Pierce), but does have the top-4 pass-catchers healthy: DeVonta, Goedert, Wicks, Lemon. PIT thin at WR expecting 2-WR sets Metcalf/Bernard.
items.why: Hurts/Saquon/Shipley out; healthy skill players. PIT missing Pittman/Wilson/Skowronek.
items.implication: PHI pass-catchers viable with McKee; Metcalf high share.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey has no injury designation for Sunday’s game.
items.why: Cleared, no designation after prior foot concern.
items.implication: Full go with Quentin Johnston also IN.
items.opportunity: Reliable WR usage in Chargers offense.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson diagnosed with high-ankle sprain, surprised he could practice; NE plays Thursday next so may be availability test.
items.why: High-ankle sprain; practiced, feels good but Q. Levitan unclear.
items.implication: Risky start; Patriots tried out RBs.
items.opportunity: If limited/out, Rhamondre or others expand.

items.text: Cardinals ruled out RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) for Sunday’s game vs the Rams.
items.implication: Cardinals RB depth impacted vs Rams.

items.text: LOVE Mike Evans vs WSH as WR4; Commanders defense buffet for pass catchers.
LOVE Kyren Williams vs ARI as RB5; elite recent usage vs leaky run D.
HATE Jaylen Waddle vs SEA as WR28; ugly matchup.
items.why: Seattle tough pass D and shaky QB context.
